notes.title: Fixed the Missing Audio Bug in the Demo Version
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow enthusiasts we have yet to meet!{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159778/6911b72ff967f7062646bbc620c94c5ff6add96c.png



First and foremost, please accept our sincerest apologies. Thanks to the feedback from one of our players, we discovered a bug in the demo where the audio and sound effects were missing. After a thorough investigation, we have successfully fixed the issue and released a new version. We deeply regret not being able to ensure a complete gaming experience in time, and we apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.



At the same time, we are incredibly grateful for your patience and support. It is your feedback and enthusiasm that drive us to continually improve and refine the quality of Wordban.



Looking ahead, we will continue to give our all to bring you more and better Sokoban puzzle experiences. Please keep following and supporting Wordban as we walk this journey with Wordo together.


Black Banana Studio
Beibi Technology Co., Ltd.
